history.dynasty: None (modern; International Society for Krishna Consciousness)
history.period: Founded 2009 per Trawell.in; construction began in the early 2000s and the temple was inaugurated in 2014 per Kanpur Tourism (dates conflict - verify)
history.summary: ISKCON Kanpur (Sri Sri Radha Madhava Mandir) on Mainavati Marg, Bithoor Road, Kanpur. It grew from a small assembly of local devotees into a large complex (about 12 acres per most sources) with the main white marble temple housing Sri Sri Radha Madhav alongside Gaura Nitai and Jagannath-Baladeva-Subhadra, plus a guesthouse, vegetarian restaurant, library, gift shop, goshala and gardens. Construction was done in phases with devotee donations; sources disagree on the founding/inauguration year (2009 vs 2014).

name: ISKCON Temple Kanpur
town_description: Kanpur is Uttar Pradesh's major industrial city on the south bank of the Ganga, about 80 km west of Lucknow. Once called the 'Manchester of the East', it is today a large commercial and educational centre with several prominent temples.

travel.road: Mainavati Marg, Bithoor Road, Kanpur; reachable by taxi and auto-rickshaw

visitor_information.best_time: November to February (Janmashtami in August is the biggest festival)
